Korankei is still green this week, but the dates are set. The 71st Korankei Momiji Matsuri runs from 1 to 30 November in Asuke, Toyota City, with the maples on Mt Iimori lit up from sunset until 9pm every night. Entry's free, though parking isn't. The forecasters put peak colour somewhere between 16 and 23 November this year. If your trip falls in the second half of November, this is the valley I'd add.
